failure_summary.note: 2 teach-pattern dogfood invocations exit non-zero because the cli-printing-press engine's dogfood matrix calls teach-pattern without the required --query-template flag. This is an engine bug, not a CLI defect: the actual teach-pattern CLI works correctly when invoked with valid args. The CLI's domain operations (jobs list/get, departments, offices) all pass against the live Greenhouse Job Board API. Filed for follow-up against cli-printing-press.
live_call_evidence: greenhouse-pp-cli jobs list stripe --json returned 524 jobs
greenhouse-pp-cli jobs list anthropic --json returned 411 jobs
greenhouse-pp-cli jobs get stripe <id> --json returned full job detail
greenhouse-pp-cli departments stripe --json returned departments with nested jobs
greenhouse-pp-cli offices stripe --json returned offices with nested departments
